vulnerability_summary: OpenClaw Feishu webhook mode accepted forged events when verificationToken was configured without encryptKey.
causality: The imported community plugin's human initial release 4286755f made encryptKey optional. Human atomic PR commit 7958fbb1 then created monitorWebhook and the exact Lark.adaptDefault(..., { autoChallenge: true }) request path that made the optional-key design reachable. Claude-coauthored follow-up 1173e7ea only refactored dispatcher ownership and left that request line byte-for-byte unchanged. OpenClaw commits 2267d58a and b0c67ea0/5c2cb6c5 were upstream synchronization copies; the imported files differ from upstream only by formatting. The AI signals are bound to refactoring/synchronization, while the vulnerable atomic source contribution is human.
